top_signals.title: World launches World ID suite for banks, makes Zoom deepfake check generally available
top_signals.summary: World ID for Zoom is generally available after a beta that began in April, and is designed to spot deepfaked participants on Zoom calls.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
